title: Adding doubles like 6 + 6

explain.say: Look at your two hands. Each has 5 fingers, so 5 and 5 make 10. That is a double! On the board, 6 counters are joined by 6 more. Double 6 is 12.
A double means adding a number to itself. Here 3 and 3 make 6. See the two matching sets? A ladybird with 3 spots on each wing has 6 spots. What is double 4?
Here is double 5: the top row of 5 and the bottom row of 5 make 10. The frame is full! Doubles are easy to remember because both parts match. What is double 6?
Double 6 is 12. The first frame fills up with 10, and 2 spill into the next frame. Think of an egg box with 6 on each side: 6 and 6 make 12 eggs! Can you see the 2 extra?
Fantastic! Now a clever trick called near doubles. 6 plus 7 is double 6 and 1 more, so 13. Wow: in dominoes, the double tiles have the same dots on both ends! What is 7 plus 8?

faq.a: A double is a number added to itself, like 4 plus 4 or 6 plus 6. Doubling means making twice as many.
Near doubles are sums of two numbers next to each other, like 6 plus 7. Use the double you know, 6 plus 6 is 12, then add 1 more to get 13.
asks: How do I add 6 and 7 fast?

faq.a: Yes. A double is two equal groups, so it always splits into pairs. Double any whole number and the answer is even.

faq.q: Is doubling the same as times 2?
faq.a: Yes. Double 6 is 6 plus 6, which is the same as 2 times 6. Both give 12.
asks: Is double the same as multiplying by 2?

facts: Doubling any whole number always gives an even number.

wrong.1: 88 just writes 8 twice; it is not adding.

quiz.say: Use near doubles. What is 7 plus 8?

wrong.1: 14 is double 7; you forgot the 1 more.
